title: 第12章 代替水泥的史莱姆水泥又出金了第13章 修好城墙
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
在查看了登记的所有人后，林恩就安排他们该砍树的砍树，该烧木炭的烧木炭，挖土的挖土，烧砖头的烧砖头，宰杀成年史莱姆收集液体。
这些安排好后，超人林恩就不行了。
想想那些公司，企业，班干部，小领导，企业，管理十几个人，几十人都能经常出乱子，就可想而知，林恩在一天之内安排好几百名人的分组干活有多强，多累人了。
这一切安排好后，不到两个小时就天黑了。
回到自己住的木制小城堡里，林恩基本上倒头就想睡，只不过他今天没有听到哈米莉的抱怨声，只听到了一名老师和学生在一起学习的声音。
“莉莉姆老师，你好厉害，一下子就学会了书上的内容！”达尼娅发出一声惊叹，不断的夸奖起莉莉姆：“老师，你是怎么做到一次就能放好的啊！”
莉莉姆嘴角完全压不住：“当然，我可是sss级天赋，适应能力很好！”莉莉姆的尾巴不断的摇摆，十分欢快。
嗯，看来他们相处的挺好的嘛，林恩如此想着，还是倒头就睡了。
......
第二天，林恩刚来到火铜矮人的房子就得到了他们的效忠，以及条件。
帮林恩做事，要是办的好就让矮人们在这里生活，获得自由身份。
本来林恩就打算建好城墙后发展出领地的经济就进行废奴的，十分大方的同意了。
随即林恩就将他的图纸给矮人们看了。
中式城墙，十分厚实，不同于西方爱用石头建造薄皮城墙，开凿山脉获得石材，需要大量的人力物力，中式城墙主打一个性价比，大量使用土来填充，还有烧制砖头也基本上是一些好获取的原材料。、
效果很好，因为是用土，根据历史记载，就算到了小日子入侵那会，城墙连小日子的小口径火炮都能抗的住。
在这个存在魔法的世界，使用这种城墙其实会更好，魔法世界的奇幻种族会有更加强大的力量去摧毁城墙，这个世界的人使用魔法符文加强，如果使用土质城墙，兽人，魔族，魔物，魔兽，就不可能一下子就把城墙击碎。
奈何他们太迷信魔法力量了，忘记发展物理了。
土质城墙优点很多，缺点就是不能像城堡那样造的小而已。
其他全部都是优点。
防御火炮的好手，更不用提那是魔兽的撞击了。

因为土质城墙造大一点，跟直接造一个土山有什么区别？
木炭只要有原始森林要多少有多少，砖头只需要泥土。
中式城墙最费钱的就是由糯米鸡蛋清组成的特色的水泥了。
不过这个可以用其他东西代替嘛。
史密斯看了图纸后是啧啧称奇：“我见过将山开凿成城堡的工程，也见过使用大理石精美雕刻上魔法阵的城墙，就从来没有见过这里的城墙。”
林恩询问他最关心的事情：“这样的城墙，怎么样，根据我自己的计算来看，防御效果会很好。”
content_en:
After checking the registered owners, Linn arranged for them to chop down trees if they should, burn charcoal for those who should burn charcoal, dig soil for those who should dig, burn bricks for those who should burn bricks, and kill adult slimes to collect liquid.
After these arrangements were made, Superman Lynn couldn't do it.
Think about those companies, enterprises, class cadres, small leaders, enterprises, and management of more than a dozen or dozens of people that often cause trouble. You can imagine how powerful and tiring it is for Lin En to arrange hundreds of people to work in groups in one day.
After all this was arranged, it got dark in less than two hours.
Back in the small wooden castle where he lived, Linn basically fell asleep, but he didn't hear Hamili's complaints today, only the sound of a teacher and students studying together.
"Teacher Lilim, you are so amazing. You learned the contents of the book in one fell swoop!" Dania exclaimed and continued to praise Lilim: "Teacher, how did you manage to put it all in one go?"
Lilim couldn't hold back her mouth at all: "Of course, I am a SSS-level talent, and I have very good adaptability!" Lilim's tail kept wagging, very cheerfully.
Well, it seems they get along well, Linn thought, and fell asleep.
...
The next day, as soon as Linn arrived at the house of the Fire Bronze Dwarves, he received their allegiance and conditions.
Help Linn do something, and if it goes well, let the dwarves live here and gain free status.
Originally, Lin En planned to abolish slavery after building the city wall and developing the territory's economy, so he agreed very generously.
Linn then showed his drawings to the dwarves.
Chinese-style city walls are very thick. Unlike the West, which prefers to use stone to build thin-skinned city walls. Excavation of mountains to obtain stone requires a lot of manpower and material resources. Chinese-style city walls focus on cost-effectiveness, using a large amount of soil to fill them, and fired bricks are basically some easy-to-obtain raw materials. ,
The effect is very good, because it is made of earth. According to historical records, even when Xiaori invaded, the city wall could withstand even Xiaori's small-caliber artillery.
In this world where magic exists, it would actually be better to use this kind of city wall. The fantasy races in the magic world will have more powerful power to destroy the city wall. People in this world use magic runes to strengthen it. If you use earthen city walls, orcs, demons, monsters, and monsters, it will be impossible to destroy the city wall at once.
However, they were too superstitious about magical power and forgot to develop physics.
Earthen city walls have many advantages, but the disadvantage is that they cannot be built as small as a castle.
Everything else is a plus.
A master at defending against artillery, not to mention the impact of a monster.
Because building a larger earthen city wall is different from building an earthen mountain directly?
Charcoal is available as long as there is virgin forest, and bricks only require soil.
The most expensive part of the Chinese city wall is the characteristic cement composed of glutinous rice and egg whites.
But this can be replaced with something else.
After looking at the drawings, Smith was amazed: "I have seen the project of carving a mountain into a castle, and I have also seen the city wall with the magic circle carved with marble, but I have never seen the city wall here."
Linn asked what he was most concerned about: "How about such a city wall? According to my own calculations, the defensive effect will be very good."
